inputs.text: An 85 mm medium shot at chest height, straight on, holds a girl standing square to the lens on a rain-wet city street, both hands cupped at the centre of her chest with palms up, a small churning bead of glowing cyan water spraying into fine curls above her fingers while a huge translucent whale-shaped water spirit surges out from behind her left shoulder, a gold four-point star glinting in its current. Her weight sits evenly on both bare legs, elbows tucked in, shoulders rounded gently forward, head upright with a slight tilt, gaze locked into the lens. Her face is illustrated as clean stylized 2D anime — short rounded skull, small soft chin, small nose, small ears, wide-set eyes, one soft blush low on each cheek, delicate contours, graphic feature definition — its colour and shading following the one key light: matched colour temperature, naturally placed highlights, shaped shadows running over the illustrated features rather than sculpted surface modelling. Her eyes are large almonds, a deep saturated teal outer ring graduating into a luminous pale-aqua centre, matte irises each holding a single small catchlight and a scatter of tiny star points low in the pupil, crisp dark lash lines, heavy upper lashes; her brows lie flat with a faint inner lift, her small mouth rests a few millimetres open at the centre, expression level and faintly wondering. Her torso is fully three-dimensional — anatomical volume, natural body-plane transitions, physically consistent shading across chest, abdomen, waist and shoulders — the skin carrying flesh density, warm light passing under the surface, subsurface scattering, shadow settling into the collarbone hollows and the fold of the elbow, a broad sheen band across each cheekbone dimming toward the jaw, dry throughout. A pleated navy hood-cap sits low on her crown, banded with pale gold trigram marks, gold tassel charms and small green tags hanging at both sides, a single fine ahoge springing up through it; blunt heavy bangs split into thick pointed locks across her brows, two large wing-shaped clumps flaring out beside each cheek, roots deep sea-green shifting through cobalt to pale mint at the tips, a longer mass falling behind her shoulders. A white high-collared blouse sits under a broad green shawl collar printed with pale celadon cloud-scroll motifs, its throat closed by a small red ribbon bow and a round blue orb pendant ringed with white cloud shapes and a gold edge; a white belt with gold rings cinches her waist; a long dark teal coat splits into two panels reaching her shins, hem and lapels edged in gold scrolling with pale cyan lining, russet velvet trim riding her shoulders, a circular openwork bronze charm ball hanging at her left hip. Sand-coloured shorts with teal cloud-scroll trim bare her whole thighs, wide white cuffs turned back from her wrists with teal scroll patterns. The cloth is fully three-dimensional in geometry and material: real thickness, layered construction, tension, gravity-driven draping, folds with genuine depth, coherent self-shadowing, ambient occlusion, continuous light gradients across ridges and valleys, its cotton and wool matte, darker in the creases, dry at the raised edges. Hair holds an intermediate 2.5D treatment, a dense layered mass of defined locks, overlapping strands, soft occlusion between layers, individual strands visible along the silhouette and in lit sections, broad smooth highlight bands sweeping the crown and following its flow, a few fine lifted strands catching light, highlights kept painterly and controlled. Hard mirror-sharp reflections appear on the lacquer charm ball, the polished bronze and the glazed orb alone, each carrying the light source as a clean rectangle bending along the curve. Behind her the street recedes in wet grey-blue paving whose polished surface mirrors the sky in broken streaks, a cast-iron lamp burning warm amber mid-distance on the right, dim façades and a pale sunset band beyond, thin rain falling at a slant, dark green leaves crowding the top right corner; one soft key from the front-left, a cool blue bounce off the wet stone, a light haze layer, 85 mm at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, mild bloom. Physically based anime rendering: painted anime face, three-dimensional PBR body and cloth, 2.5D hair, one unifying light.
